Q1: How should each gate job record its remaining core allowance and reset time?
Choices:
A) Change the existing `GH_PAT_BUDGET phase=start|end ... job=<name>` lines in every gate job so they fill `remaining=` and `reset=` from one `GET /rate_limit` read (it does not use up the allowance). Add no new prefix. If the read fails, the line falls back to `unknown`. The acceptance check becomes "a gate run prints the filled `GH_PAT_BUDGET` line twice per job". (RECOMMENDED)
B) Leave the `GH_PAT_BUDGET` lines as they are (`remaining=unknown`) and add a separate `GATE_RATE_LIMIT job=<name> stage=<start|end> remaining=<n> reset_epoch=<n>` line next to each one. Register it as a new stable log prefix. This keeps the issue's wording, but each job then logs two start lines and two end lines with overlapping meaning.
C) Do both: fill `remaining=`/`reset=` on the existing `GH_PAT_BUDGET` lines and also print the new `GATE_RATE_LIMIT` line, sharing the same single `/rate_limit` read.
